findings.text: follow-on: the case's docstring was rewritten to name the stack base, but it states without qualification that the base 'is placed afresh by the kernel on every exec, and it is what moves here' — the caveat the code docstring now carries (reckon/crew/process_signal.py:196-202) is absent from the test, so on a host running under setarch -R or an ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE personality this case reddens with no code regression while its own text says the movement is unconditional.

justification.durability: the delta adds no assertion, so durability rests on the case at tests/test_a_process_table_is_read_once_per_beat.py:347 ('a re-exec moves the identity even when the path does not'), which reddens if the stack-base field is dropped from _process_identity; negative-control-f18ecdd0deb.log records that reverting the field fails the same-binary re-exec case at EXIT=1.
justification.evidence: the gate result is recorded, not claimed: test-a-process-table-is-read-once-per-beat.log names revision f34c4cfb72113bb9bfe1c986508878565253b024 and ends '9 passed' / EXIT=0, matching the manifest's tests line, and I re-ran tests/test_a_process_table_is_read_once_per_beat.py at head (9 passed, 2.92 s).
justification.fit: the added prose stays in the surrounding module's idiom (private helpers documented by what they observe, reckon/crew/process_signal.py:186-202) and introduces no plan, phase or version label.
justification.goal_fidelity: the delta brings the three docstrings to the key the walk at reckon/crew/process_signal.py:245-249 compares (start tick, executable path, stack base) and states the stack-base field's limit at :196-202, which is the goal's own subject documented rather than a new mechanism.
justification.reuse: the delta adds no definition; the mechanism it documents was already found to have no pre-existing owner in the repository (a search over reckon/ for stack-base or exec-detection keying returned none), and the field reader it uses is reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:320 _process_stat_fields.
justification.scope_discipline: git diff --stat e36a760d6..f34c4cfb7 lists only reckon/crew/process_signal.py and tests/test_a_process_table_is_read_once_per_beat.py, both declared, and the commit carries no code change beyond comment text.

notes: incremental review: the base is the head of the prior review (e36a760d6e791bfe66c5c3ee86302d64c33f3ee8, recorded in review-records/...at-e36a760d6e791bfe66c5c3ee86302d64c33f3ee8.json) and the head is f34c4cfb72113bb9bfe1c986508878565253b024. The delta answers all three follow-on findings that review left in each of the two files it scoped.
